name: Trento (Italy)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, light blue and yellow, the light blue charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Trento (a black eagle on white).
history: Municipal flag of Trento, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Trento arms — black eagle on white, crowned
